witness_semantics: witness/<aid>.py runs the artifact's solve.py, then checks: plant outflow <= supply, each warehouse inflow equals demand converted from boxes to pieces (1 box = 10 pieces), each warehouse receives at least 20 pieces from P2, reported objective equals cost recomputed from data/costs.csv and equals the reference optimum (tolerance 1e-6).

correct.description: Correct LP: box-to-piece conversion applied, >=20 pieces from P2 per warehouse enforced.

b_m1.description: The '>= 20 pieces from P2' rule is flipped to '<= 20'; with total supply equal to total demand this makes the model infeasible, so no valid solution is produced.

b_m2.description: Box-to-piece conversion is dropped: demands are read as 80/90/80 pieces instead of 800/900/800, so warehouses are under-supplied and the objective deviates from the reference.

b_e1.description: Equivalent rewrite: P2 minimum enforced as variable lower bounds, demand equality split into two inequalities; same feasible set and objective.
